note: Founded by Hudson Griffith (CEO) and Marinos Eliades, both previously engineers at Gander (YC F24, a fleet-management platform acquired by Archer Aviation NYSE:ACHR); Hudson was later an engineer at Suno. Prized appears to have pivoted/repositioned: its Launch HN post (2026-07-30, 'Launch HN: Prized (YC S26)') described it as letting non-engineer staff build secure internal tools, while its current YC profile and website (checked 2026-09-30) describe it as 'a cloud devbox that feels local.' No funding amount, round, or investor names were found in any public source; treat total_funding_usd and last_round as unknown rather than assumed.
